study: MNIST robustness with translation and Gaussian noise augmentation

split.algorithm: For labels 0..9 in order, permute original training indices using one numpy.default_rng(2026); take first 500 for validation. Sort final train and validation indices separately. Official test set remains unchanged.

model.initialization: W1 He normal, W2 normal sqrt(1/128), zero biases

optimizer.name: Adam
optimizer.l2_applies_to: W1 and W2 only, added to gradient before Adam; not AdamW

augmentation.joint_order: shift then noise; independent Bernoulli decisions

random_streams.fairness: all methods draw both augmentation streams every batch, even if unused; same initialization and permutations for each seed

validation.criterion: unweighted average accuracy of the four conditions; earliest epoch wins ties

test.joint_0.20: all four 2-pixel shifts, each followed by independent Gaussian noise
test.shift4: all four axial directions, 4 pixels; amplitude extrapolation stress test

corruption_generation: float32 inputs; rng.normal(size=batch.shape).astype(float32); use one stream per condition and reset to the documented phase seed; same noise stream reused across pure-noise severities; direction-major then original-image-major ordering; clip to [0,1]. SHA256 hashes cover concatenated C-order little-endian float32 image bytes and int64 labels, recorded separately.
test_policy: Finish all 20 training runs before loading official test arrays and evaluating validation-selected checkpoints. No test-guided tuning.
statistics: Mean and sample standard deviation over five optimization seeds on one fixed official split. Corrupted views of the same image are not independent test subjects. No statistical-significance claim.
